title: When People are Floods: Analyzing Dehumanizing Metaphors in Immigration Discourse with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the prevalence of dehumanizing metaphors (e.g., likening immigrants to animals, vermin, parasites, or floods) in social media discourse using a combination of zero-shot LLM prompting for word-level detection and SBERT document embeddings for discourse-level conceptual associations.
